cohort: 21,225 participants with electronic birth records from the Urguu Maternity Hospital in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia (9544 in 2008 and 11,681 in 2018)
finding: The odds of having a cesarean delivery were highest among mothers classified in Robson classification group 5 in both 2008 and 2018, suggesting healthcare providers should work with these mothers to increase their willingness to give birth vaginally after a previous cesarean delivery.
